decision_basis.owner_direction_binding: current repository-governance transcript: preregister the d37395d coalesce plus 600-second news_poll misfire remediation, include tests, and return it for review

observed_defect.root_cause_class: scheduler event-loop stalls crossed news_poll due times while the effective APScheduler misfire grace remained at its one-second default
observed_defect.data_plane_disposition: all 186 fired runs were terminal ok; incremental-floor successors recovered the delayed range; no data loss or trade-side effect was observed

required_behavior: JobSpec gains one optional positive job-local misfire_grace_time value; omission preserves APScheduler's existing default
the scheduler continues to install coalesce=true and max_instances=1 for every scheduled job and passes a misfire grace only when the JobSpec explicitly declares one

register_news_poll_job declares misfire_grace_time=600 whether its trigger is enabled or disabled; when enabled the installed APScheduler news_poll job has coalesce=true, max_instances=1 and misfire_grace_time=600
multiple overdue news_poll fire times are coalesced to the latest one and at most one late invocation is eligible; elapsed lateness greater than 600 seconds is still missed
the remediation introduces no job-internal retry, manual replacement run, duplicate slot replay, reservation or acceptance-gate weakening
jobs without an explicit grace retain the existing scheduler default; poll_market_snapshot is not modified and does not receive the news_poll grace

required_assertions: the registered news_poll JobSpec declares exactly 600 seconds and retains the frozen v2.1 trigger route
the installed APScheduler news_poll job has coalesce=true, max_instances=1 and misfire_grace_time=600
an ordinary scheduled JobSpec with no grace keeps the APScheduler one-second default
invalid non-positive or boolean JobSpec grace values fail closed before scheduler start
the frozen 61/64/64 slot contract, Monday suppression and 09:50 recovery remain unchanged
required_commands: .venv/bin/ruff check src/alphapilot/jobs/registry.py src/alphapilot/jobs/scheduler.py src/alphapilot/jobs/news_poll.py tests/test_phase2_jobs.py tests/test_p4_news_poll.py

explicit_non_goals: do not modify config/p4_news_poll_v2_1.yaml or any prior preregistration, evidence, receipt or verdict
do not modify news-poll trigger times, request budgets, pagination, deduplication, PIT timestamps, checkpoints, sources, database writes or trading behavior
do not modify scheduler plist, launchd state, environment variables or poll_market_snapshot
do not rerun backlog migration, incremental validation, deployment or activation
do not start or backfill the new observation window before independent implementation review and a controlled scheduler process refresh
do not mark P4.1 complete or unlock P4.2b or P4.3
